changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FieldJsonProperty') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FieldJsonProperty]( [FieldID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Parent] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Path] [nvarchar](500) NOT NULL, [Position] [int] NOT NULL, [IsArray] [bit] NOT NULL, [Value] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_FieldJsonProperty_CreatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_FieldJsonProperty_CreatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_FieldJsonProperty_UpdatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_FieldJsonProperty_UpdatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FieldJsonProperty] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [FieldID] ASC, [Position] ASC, [Parent] ASC, [Name] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FieldJsonProperty_Field') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldJsonProperty] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldJsonProperty_Field] FOREIGN KEY([FieldID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Field] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldJsonProperty] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldJsonProperty_Field] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_FieldJsonProperty_Field_Path') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_FieldJsonProperty_Field_Path] ON [dbo].[FieldJsonProperty] ( [FieldID] DESC, [Path] ASC ) END

IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'PK_FieldJsonProperty' and type_desc = 'CLUSTERED') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldJsonProperty] DROP CONSTRAINT [PK_FieldJsonProperty]
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldJsonProperty] ADD CONSTRAINT [PK_FieldJsonProperty] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [FieldID] ASC, [Position] ASC, [Parent] ASC, [Name] ASC )
END
